국내외 주요 HR 동향을 발굴하여 조직과 인재관리의 변화를 살펴봅니다.

<span class="pic-trends-marker" hidden></span>

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  function addReadLinks() {
    const posts = document.querySelectorAll(
      'body:has(.pic-trends-marker) .quarto-listing-default .quarto-post'
    );

    posts.forEach(function (post) {
      if (post.querySelector('.pic-entry-read')) return;

      const titleLink = post.querySelector('.listing-title a[href]');
      const description = post.querySelector('.listing-description');
      const body = post.querySelector('.body');

      if (!titleLink || !body) return;

      const link = document.createElement('a');
      link.className = 'pic-entry-read';
      link.href = titleLink.href;
      link.textContent = '원문 읽기';

      if (description) {
        description.insertAdjacentElement('afterend', link);
      } else {
        body.appendChild(link);
      }
    });
  }

  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', addReadLinks);
  window.addEventListener('load', addReadLinks);

  const observer = new MutationObserver(addReadLinks);
  observer.observe(document.documentElement, {
    childList: true,
    subtree: true
  });
})();
</script>
```
